SELECT time_bucket, AVG(ratio) AS value FROM ( SELECT time_bucket, CASE WHEN COUNT(engagement_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY time_bucket) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(engagement_rate) FILTER (WHERE engagement_rate < #{dropOffThreshold} AND engagement_rate != 0.0) OVER (PARTITION BY time_bucket) / COUNT(engagement_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY time_bucket)::double precision END AS ratio FROM ( SELECT time_bucket, SUM(upper(segment) - LOWER(segment)) / SUM(video_time)::double precision AS engagement_rate FROM video_play_segment play_segment JOIN video_play_session play_session ON play_session.id = play_segment.session_id AND play_session.master_id = #{masterId} JOIN gc_video video ON play_session.video_id = video.id AND video.video_time != 0
AND video.id IN
#{videoId}
RIGHT JOIN
( SELECT #{filter.start}::timestamp with time zone AS time_bucket UNION SELECT #{filter.end}::timestamp with time zone ) AS time_bucket ON play_segment.update_time <= time_bucket
generate_series(#{filter.start}, #{filter.end}, concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval) AS time_bucket ON play_segment.update_time >= time_bucket AND play_segment.update_time < time_bucket + concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval
GROUP BY time_bucket, play_segment.session_id ORDER BY time_bucket ) AS engagement ) AS drop_off GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket;
